quotes.name: Sincerity
quotes.text: Sincerity is the key of the divine doors; it is the condition of all progress. To be sincere is to have no other dynamic motive than the desire to find the Divine and serve Him.

quotes.name: Humility
quotes.text: True humility consists in knowing that without the Divine Grace we are nothing, and that our only strength is the strength of the Divine working through us.

quotes.name: Gratitude
quotes.text: Gratitude is a loving vibration of the soul turned toward the Divine. It is the sweetest of all vibrations that can rise from the heart.

quotes.name: Aspiration
quotes.text: To feel the Divine presence constantly in all things and all movements. The lotus is the flower of quiet, ascending aspiration.

quotes.name: Peace
quotes.text: Om is the signature of the Infinite. It is the unmanifest sound from which all manifestation rises, bringing peace and cosmic expansion to the mind.

quotes.name: Peace
quotes.text: In the silence of the mind, the divine force acts and transforms the nature. Speak only when necessary and let your words arise from that deep peace.

quotes.name: Aspiration
quotes.text: The overlapping triangles represent the ascent of human aspiration and the descent of the Divine Grace. The square in the center represents manifestation, and the lotus represents realization.

quotes.name: Rose
quotes.text: Pure, constant, and complete; the offering of the heart at the feet of the Mother. A rose blooms in silent devotion, seeking only to give its fragrance.
